job.title: $15/hour | Repair Assistant | No Experience Required!
job.description:
Position: Repair Assistant 

Location: Semmes, AL

Pay: $15/hour

Experience: No prior experience required — training will be provided!

Education: High school diploma or GED preferred.

Clark Personnel is seeking a Repair Assistant to join a growing and dynamic team! This is an entry-level position responsible for supporting the repair, maintenance, and refinishing of boat propellers in a shop environment. This role is ideal for a dependable, hands-on individual who is eager to learn a skilled trade and grow within a marine service setting.

  3. Use grinders, sanders, polishers, and other basic shop tools under supervision.
  4. Assist with straightening blades, welding prep, and finishing work.
  5. Help balance propellers and ensure proper pitch and performance standards.
  6. Support sanding, buffing, and polishing for the final finish quality.
  7. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe workspace.
  8. Follow all safety procedures and properly use personal protective equipment (PPE).
  9. Move propellers and materials throughout the shop safely.
  10. Assist with inventory, tool organization, and supply tracking.
  11. Perform general shop duties such as equipment cleanup, trash removal, and basic maintenance tasks.

  1. Mechanical aptitude or interest in working with tools and hands-on tasks
  2. Ability to follow directions and learn new skills quickly
  3. Dependable, punctual, and strong work ethic
